Preserve feed scrolling and restore public pin navigation after hiding a login wall.

- Preserve the original scroll container so load-more listeners receive scrolling.
- Release supported fixed-wrapper and pointer locks without creating nested scrollers.
- Let public pin image links navigate normally instead of triggering another signup wall.
- Keep pin buttons, unrelated dialogs, and intentional account pages available.

Download the ZIP for your browser. Chrome supports unpacked installation; the Firefox ZIP is a temporary developer preview and is not store-signed. Installation steps are in the repository README.
